newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares bounce back after 8-day losses.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares bounce back after 8-day losses.

text.p: Slovenian shares reversed an eight-day losing streak on Thursday, rebounding 2.41 percent on the perception prices may have bottomed out, traders said.
"It seems prices have bottomed out. A further rebound could be in store tomorrow as well but next week the market will likely consolidate unless there're fresh incentives," one said.
During the eight-day losing streak the blue-chip SBI index had lost 7.2 percent.
* The SBI index rose 32.84 points to 1,394.91.
* Overall 14 shares rose, three fell and nine were untraded.
* Bank SKB had the highest turnover, firming 0.44 percent to 57,000 tolars on volume of 678 shares for total turnover of 38.9 million tolars. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
